title: Private school management and staff members stage protest in Dharwad

ai.summary: Private school staff and management in Dharwad staged a protest demanding pension scheme implementation, notional pay benefits, and filling of vacant posts in aided schools and colleges.

facts.claim: Private educational institutions and their employees staged a protest in Dharwad on Tuesday
facts.quote: Private educational institutions and their employees staged a protest in Dharwad on Tuesday

facts.claim: The protest was organised by the Coordination Committee of Private Educational Institutions Managements and Employees
facts.quote: The protest was organised by the Coordination Committee of Private Educational Institutions Managements and Employees

facts.claim: One of the major demands was the implementation of the old pension scheme, along with notional pay benefits, for employees of aided educational institutions appointed after April 1, 2006
facts.quote: One of the major demands was the implementation of the old pension scheme, along with notional pay benefits, for employees of aided educational institutions appointed after April 1, 2006, in accordance with a High Court order.

facts.claim: The committee also sought the filling of vacant posts in aided schools and colleges that have remained unfilled since 2015
facts.quote: The committee also sought the filling of vacant posts in aided schools and colleges that have remained unfilled since 2015

ai.background_note: Private school staff and management in Dharwad staged a protest demanding pension scheme implementation, notional pay benefits, and filling of vacant posts in aided schools and colleges.
